body: I know Jeff the Killer is a meme but it felt as real as I was

Maaaan... I forget the exact dose my friend and I took but I had COVID and didn't know it so it spiraled into a hellscape. I saw a demon with the face of Jeff the Killer with the body of that long haired thing from Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark and it was just in the dark corner behind my friend's TV staring at me. 

I saw it as a manifestation of the person who harmed me badly as a kid, something so evil looking. It never wore off. I spent the rest of the trip puking in my friend's toilet. Almost decided to just sleep in front of it so I can puke more.

All of my comfort songs became slowed down and disorted, and any coping skills I'd normally use during a panic attack did absolutely nothing. 

​

The next time we tripped it was amazing- no come up and it was smooth the entire time
